title: The Credit Score Myth That Costs You Thousands
hook_text: CARRYING A BALANCE KILLS YOUR SCORE

beats.say: Carrying a credit card balance doesn't build your credit score at all.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a dark metallic credit card resting on a cold slate surface under dim overhead light.

beats.say: That's one of the most expensive myths you've been told. Stay to learn the exact math.
beats.visual: A steaming ceramic coffee cup beside an open ledger on a dark wooden desk, moody lighting.

beats.say: Banks want you to believe that paying interest proves you're a good borrower.
beats.visual: Heavy glass skyscraper facade reflecting gray afternoon clouds, shot from a low upward angle.

beats.say: It doesn't. It just makes them rich while you lose hundreds of dollars.
beats.visual: A solitary brass key resting on a heavy oak table, cinematic side lighting casting long shadows.

beats.say: Look at what happens with a $3,000 balance at 24% APR.
beats.visual: A glowing desk lamp casting a warm amber pool of light over a blank leather notepad.

beats.say: If you only pay the minimum each month, it takes 183 months to pay off.
beats.visual: A minimalist mechanical clock on a concrete wall, hands blurred in a long exposure shot.

beats.say: You'll end up handing over $4,887 just in interest charges.
beats.visual: Close up of heavy silver coins stacked neatly on a dark slate surface, moody shadows.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about how scoring actually works.
beats.visual: A pair of hands sliding a dark leather wallet across a smooth marble tabletop.

beats.say: Your credit score only cares about two things: payment history and credit utilization.
beats.visual: An old brass fountain pen resting beside a blank sheet of heavy cream paper.

beats.say: Utilization is just how much of your limit you use compared to your total limit.
beats.visual: A tall glass of water catching morning light on a rustic wooden windowsill.

beats.say: You don't need to carry a balance or pay a dime of interest to prove anything.
beats.visual: A sleek silver pen resting on a dark walnut clipboard under soft overhead lighting.

beats.say: Just pay your statement in full every single month, and that's exactly how
beats.visual: A hand closing a dark leather notebook on a quiet desk as the room fades to shadow.

caption: Carrying a balance does zero for your credit score. Pay in full every month and keep your money. #moneytips #personalfinance #creditscore #financialliteracy #debtfree
description: Stop paying interest to build credit. Learn how credit utilization actually works and why carrying a balance is a costly myth.
first_comment: Did you used to believe carrying a balance helped your score?
